subject.title: Subagent lifecycle observability + async supervision controls

question: Should subagent lifecycle receipts and cancel/steer/resume supervision be modeled as extensions of the existing audit/task/artifact foundations, or as a separate subagent-specific ledger and API?
rationale: Current main has multiple plausible foundations, and choosing the contract fixes public RPC semantics, persisted data shape, authorization scopes, redaction policy, retention, and operator-control behavior.

options.title: Extend audit/task foundations
options.body: Add subagent lifecycle and supervision event types over the existing metadata-only audit ledger, task summaries, artifact lookup, and registry state.

options.title: Create subagent ledger
options.body: Add a dedicated subagent lifecycle/supervision table and API, accepting another durable source of truth for this workflow.

options.title: Keep current summaries only
options.body: Decline the durable receipt/control contract for now and keep audit.list, task summaries, artifacts, and subagent list/log/info as separate tools.

recommendation.title: Extend audit/task foundations
recommendation.body: Add subagent lifecycle and supervision event types over the existing metadata-only audit ledger, task summaries, artifact lookup, and registry state.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history across the audit, SQLite state, subagent control, and task lifecycle surfaces involved in the decision.
